mandatory_revisions.requirement: Add FIRST_DERIVED_SNAPSHOT_REPLAY_MANIFEST_V1 containing every promoted row with table, row_id, canonical row payload SHA-256, provenance/review SHA-256 bindings and deterministic dependency information. Table deltas remain secondary checks only.

Separate scientific_input_repo_head, promotion_contract_repo_head, and promotion_engine_repo_head/code_identity_sha256. The final manifest must bind the exact implementation actually executed, not only the pre-design scientific input head.

Publish into an execution-scoped temporary directory, write DB and manifest, fsync files and directory, verify the complete pair, then atomically rename to the final content-addressed directory. A partial or inconsistent final directory is fatal and must never be silently completed or overwritten.

After replay, re-read every promoted row and recompute its canonical row SHA-256 against FIRST_DERIVED_SNAPSHOT_REPLAY_MANIFEST_V1. Exact table counts remain an additional invariant, never a substitute for row identity verification.
